sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Full-bleed portrait 4:5 production puzzle painting, warm richly detailed oil/gouache storybook realism with subtle brush texture, coherent anatomy and perspective, no text, numerals, brands, famous places, border or UI. Complete natural scene, not a diagram. This clean plate will receive five small hand-painted animated objects later. Draw natural attachment surfaces but omit only the stated small details. Eye-level intimate view of a postcard-writing table with large CORAL PINK linen covering and softly coral wall, blank cream illustrated cards featuring only simple floral paintings, an open envelope, ink bottle, wooden pen, wax seal tools, travel journal, window to garden. No writing anywhere on paper. Provide a tiny empty ivory bud vase at right; a blank envelope in center with no loose petal on it; journal with one bare string knot; an empty short pin/hook on rear wooden rail; and a short bare plant stem in small pot left. Later details flower, loose tiny petal, string bow, hanging small feather charm, leaf sprig. Natural coherent tabletop shadows.

sources.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production hand-painted game cutout atlas. 1536x1024 RGBA with genuine transparent empty background, no glow, colored haze, grid, labels or UI. Invisible three columns/two rows, exactly five objects in reading order and sixth lower-right empty. Each WHOLE object fits central 280x300 within its 512x512 cell, all sides surrounded by at least 100 transparent pixels. Oil/gouache brush texture, coherent warm natural light from upper-left. Fine clean edges, realistic materials. For a coral-pink postcard-writing table, paint (1) a pale pink small flower on fine green stem for vase; (2) one loose rose petal lying flat seen three-quarter from above, subtle tight semitransparent contact shadow and no ground; (3) a small brown linen string bow viewed from above obliquely, gentle contact shadow; (4) a single soft white feather charm hanging vertically from a small complete brass ring and short tan loop, no clipping; (5) a tiny fresh green leafy twig with bare stem at bottom. Natural elegant botanical details.
